finding.title: Surface reorder/reset save failures to the user in the learning-order screens instead of silently swallowing them
finding.rule: EH-2 (no raw exception reaches presentation without becoming a value) + Nygard I/O-failure-halfway lens
finding.why: None of these 5 call paths (2 persist + 1 reset in track_learning_order_screen.dart; 1 reorder + 1 reset in learning_order_screen.dart) has a try/catch or .catchError. The UI has already applied the optimistic reorder to local widget state before the write lands, so if saveSedarimOrder/saveMasechtosOrder/saveOrder/resetToDefault throws (DB busy, disk full, offline outbox push failure) the screen keeps showing the new order as saved with zero error affordance and no rollback — the user believes it persisted; it silently didn't, and it reverts on next app load. Sibling screens in the same feature (edit_track_screen.dart, add_track_flow_screen.dart, track_management_hub_screen.dart) all wrap the equivalent save call in try/catch + ScaffoldMessenger SnackBar; this pair is the outlier.
finding.recommendation: Wrap each persist/reset call in try/catch (or move the mutation into a proper AsyncNotifier using AsyncValue.guard), show a SnackBar/retry matching the add_track_flow_screen.dart pattern, and revert _local*/_localOrder to the pre-optimistic value on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Widget test: stub the repository/use-case to throw on saveSedarimOrder/saveMasechtosOrder/saveOrder/resetToDefault and assert a visible error affordance appears and local state reverts
No unawaited(...persist...) or bare .then(...) without an adjacent catch remains in these two files
